summary: validate_target accepts arbitrary UNC paths, so a scan or assessment can contact any SMB host
evidence: scan.rs:63 absolute check accepts any "\\" prefix, including device paths such as \\.\PhysicalDrive0.
failure_scenario: Target "\\attacker.example\share" passes validation, reaches clamscan and std::fs::metadata, and triggers SMB authentication. Reachable through scan_start and assess_file if the webview is compromised.
